what: Waste Connections collects rubbish and recycling and runs landfills across the United States and Canada. It deliberately focuses on smaller, less competitive markets rather than big cities.
customers: Households through municipal contracts, businesses, construction sites and industrial customers.
moat: Landfill permits that are almost impossible to obtain today, in secondary markets where it is often the only operator with somewhere to put the waste.
risks: Debt of about $10 billion against almost no cash
Landfill environmental liabilities can be expensive
Fuel and labour costs rise faster than contracted price increases at times
opportunities: Revenue grew about 6% last year with pricing consistently above inflation
Waste volumes barely fall in a recession
Landfill gas projects turn a cost into an energy revenue stream
watch: Core pricing growth and the operating margin.
